## Description

Use Parabolic Stop-and-Reverse dots to trail stops and switch direction.

## Where it may fit

Clean trends with controlled retracements; repeated reversals erode performance in chop.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs, futures, FX, crypto.

## Required data

High/low prices and indicator parameters; bid/ask and cost data.

## Caveats

Can reverse too frequently; stop levels do not guarantee fills at the indicated price.
